findings.title: Race condition: daily_checkin read-modify-write atomik emas (qulflanmagan)
findings.description: daily_checkin Student qatorini with_for_update SIZ o'qiydi, so'ng streak_days/xp ni o'qib-yangilab commit qiladi. Mini App ikki marta tez bosilsa (yoki ikki qurilma) ikkala so'rov ham last_streak_date != today_str shartidan o'tib, streak/XP ikki marta beriladi (lost update / double-grant). add_xp() with_for_update ishlatadi, lekin bu metod ishlatmaydi.
findings.fix: select(Student).where(...).with_for_update() ishlatish (Postgres). SQLite-da bu no-op bo'lgani uchun ariza darajasida idempotentlikni kuchaytirish: UPDATE ... WHERE last_streak_date != today_str RETURNING orqali atomik 'band qilish', yoki DailyMood/HomeworkConfirmation kabi UniqueConstraint(user_id,date_str) bilan checkin yozuvi yaratib INSERT konfliktiga tayanish.

findings.title: award_referral_xp ikki alohida tranzaksiya — atomik emas, XP yo'qolishi mumkin
findings.description: Avval rs.xp_awarded=True qilinib BIRINCHI session commit qilinadi, keyin ALOHIDA add_xp(referrer_id, 500) chaqiriladi (yangi session). Agar add_xp orasida exception/crash bo'lsa, xp_awarded allaqachon True — referrer hech qachon 500 XP olmaydi va qayta urinishda False qaytadi. Ikki bosqich bitta tranzaksiyada emas.
findings.fix: XP qo'shishni va xp_awarded flagini bitta session/tranzaksiyada bajarish: bitta session ichida Student qatorini va ReferralStudent ni olib, XP qo'shib, flagni o'rnatib, keyin commit qilish. Yoki kamida add_xp muvaffaqiyatli bo'lgandan KEYIN flagni o'rnatish (lekin u holda double-award xavfi paydo bo'ladi — shuning uchun bitta tranzaksiya afzal).
findings.snippet:
rs.xp_awarded = True
await session.commit()
await self.add_xp(referrer_id, 500)  # alohida tranzaksiya

findings.title: get_monthly_leaderboard: DateTime ustun string bilan solishtirilmoqda (SQLite vs Postgres farqi)
findings.description: GameScore.created_at DateTime turida, lekin u string literal date_from='YYYY-MM-01' va date_to='YYYY-MM-DD 23:59:59' bilan >=/<= solishtirilmoqda. SQLite-da bu ISO sana matni leksikografik solishtirish — server_default func.now() formatiga (mikrosekundlar bormi?) bog'liq, '23:59:59' (mikrosekundsiz) chegara o'sha soniyadagi mikrosekundli yozuvlarni CHIQARIB tashlashi mumkin. Postgres-da text->timestamp implicit cast ishlaydi lekin formatga sezgir. Bundan tashqari created_at UTC (func.now), date_to esa lokal sana deb qabul qilinsa, oy chegarasida ±5 soat (Asia/Tashkent) xato.
findings.fix: String o'rniga haqiqiy datetime obyektlaridan foydalanish: date_from = datetime(year, month, 1), date_to = datetime(year, month, last_day, 23,59,59,999999). Vaqt mintaqasini aniq belgilash (created_at UTC bo'lsa, chegaralarni ham UTC ga o'tkazish). func.extract/strftime emas, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri datetime parametrlari ishlatish — SQLAlchemy driverga mos serializatsiya qiladi.

findings.title: Yetishmayotgan indekslar: Student.group_name va Student.mars_id
findings.description: Student.group_name (WHERE/ORDER BY: get_students_by_group, get_leaderboard, get_group_leaderboard, get_student_rank) va Student.mars_id (get_student_by_mars_id, find_duplicate_students) tez-tez filtrlanadi/saralanadi, lekin index=True yo'q. user_id unique (indekslangan) — yaxshi. Jadval kattalashganda full table scan.
findings.fix: group_name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(50), nullable=False, index=True) va mars_id ga index=True qo'shish. init_db da SQLite uchun CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS migratsiya ham qo'shish kerak (create_all mavjud jadvalga indeks qo'shmaydi).
findings.snippet: group_name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(50), nullable=False)  # index=True YO'Q

findings.title: N+1 query: get_absent_streak_students har student x har kun uchun alohida so'rov
findings.description: Tashqi sikl barcha studentlar bo'yicha, ichki sikl har bir sana bo'yicha — har juftlik uchun alohida AttendanceRecord SELECT. 200 student x 3 kun = 600 so'rov. Jadval o'sganda jiddiy sekinlashuv.
findings.fix: Bitta so'rovda kerakli sanalardagi barcha AttendanceRecord larni olish (WHERE date_str IN (check_dates)), Python tomonida user_id bo'yicha guruhlash (dict), keyin sikl ichida xotiradan tekshirish.

findings.title: Race condition: increment_play_in_window cooldown bypass va UniqueConstraint konflikti
findings.description: Get-or-create pattern with_for_update SIZ: ikki bir vaqtli so'rov rec topa olmasa, ikkalasi ham yangi GamePlayCount INSERT qiladi — UniqueConstraint(user_id,game_type,'cooldown') tufayli biri IntegrityError bilan yiqiladi (ushlanmagan exception). Bundan tashqari get_play_window (blocked tekshiruvi) va increment orasida atomiklik yo'q, shuning uchun 3 soatlik cooldown ikki bir vaqtli o'yin tomonidan bypass qilinishi mumkin (ikkalasi ham 'blocked=False' ko'radi).
findings.fix: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (upsert) ishlatish yoki with_for_update bilan qatorni qulflash; cooldown tekshiruvi va increment ni bitta atomik operatsiyada (UPDATE ... WHERE last_played_at < now - 3h) bajarish.
findings.snippet:
rec = result.scalar_one_or_none()
if rec: rec.play_count += 1 ...
else: session.add(GamePlayCount(...))  # bir vaqtda 2 INSERT -> IntegrityError

findings.title: Foreign key / cascade yo'q — student o'chirilganda bog'liq yozuvlar yetim qoladi
findings.description: AttendanceRecord, GameScore, GamePlayCount, DailyMood, HomeworkConfirmation, ChatMessage barchasi user_id (BigInteger) ni saqlaydi lekin Student.user_id ga ForeignKey yo'q va ON DELETE CASCADE yo'q. soft_delete_student/delete_student_by_id faqat Student qatorini o'chiradi — game_scores, attendance, mood, play_counts yetim qoladi. Monthly leaderboard get_monthly_leaderboard stu_map.get bilan None ni filtrlaydi (yaxshi), lekin yetim yozuvlar to'planib boradi va o'chirilgan studentning XP/davomat tarixi qoladi.
findings.fix: Ataylab ForeignKey ishlatilmagan bo'lishi mumkin (SQLite FK default o'chiq). Agar shunday bo'lsa, soft_delete_student ichida bog'liq yozuvlarni (kamida game_play_counts, attendance) tozalash yoki ataylab saqlanayotganini hujjatlashtirish. Aks holda ForeignKey(..., ondelete='CASCADE') qo'shish va SQLite uchun PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON.
findings.snippet: user_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(BigInteger, nullable=False, index=True)  # FK yo'q

findings.title: reset_all_xp: result.rowcount async driverlarda ishonchsiz
findings.description: Bulk update().values() WHERE siz — barcha studentlarga ta'sir qiladi (to'g'ri, ataylab). Lekin result.rowcount aiosqlite/asyncpg da har doim aniq qaytmaydi (ba'zan -1). Qaytarilgan son admin UI da ko'rsatilsa noto'g'ri bo'lishi mumkin.
findings.fix: Aniq son kerak bo'lsa, oldindan SELECT count() bilan studentlar sonini olish yoki rowcount -1 bo'lsa fallback hisoblash.

findings.title: Migration try/except pass — barcha xatolarni yutadi (data-loss xavfi past, diagnostika yo'q)
findings.description: ALTER TABLE migratsiyalari try/except: pass — ustun mavjudligi normal, lekin har QANDAY xato (sintaksis, ruxsat, jadval yo'q, disk to'la) jimgina yutiladi. DELETE FROM game_play_counts WHERE date_str != 'cooldown' (line 662) — bu data o'chiruvchi migratsiya ham except: pass ichida, agar boshqa sababdan ishlamasa bilinmaydi. ALTER lar additive bo'lgani uchun bevosita data-loss past, lekin xatolar log qilinmaydi.
findings.fix: Kamida 'duplicate column'/'already exists' xatosini ajratib, boshqa xatolarni logger.warning(exc_info=True) bilan yozish. DELETE migratsiyasini idempotent va kuzatiladigan qilish (rowcount log).
findings.snippet:
except Exception:
    pass  # barcha xatolar jimgina yutiladi

findings.title: join_game_room / update_game_progress qulflanmagan — multiplayer race
findings.description: join_game_room status=='waiting' ni o'qib, active ga o'zgartiradi — with_for_update yo'q, ikki o'yinchi bir vaqtda qo'shilsa ikkalasi ham player2 bo'lib qolishi mumkin (ikkinchisi birinchisini ustiga yozadi). update_game_progress da winner_id belgilash ham race ga ochiq (ikki finished bir vaqtda). claim_room_xp to'g'ri qulflangan (xp ikki marta berilmaydi), shuning uchun XP xavfi past, lekin g'olib/player2 noto'g'ri yozilishi mumkin.
findings.fix: join_game_room da select(...).with_for_update() ishlatish va status=='waiting' ni qulf ostida qayta tekshirish.
findings.snippet: if room and room.status == 'waiting' and room.player1_id != player2_id:  # qulf yo'q

findings.title: _calc_level chiziqli sikl — to'g'ri ishlaydi lekin level kamaymasligiga ishonch yo'q
findings.description: _calc_level mantiqan to'g'ri (xp>=min_xp bo'lgan eng yuqori levelni topadi, XP_LEVELS o'sish tartibida). _apply_xp_multiplier va LEVEL_UP_BONUS bir-biriga ta'sir qiladi: level oshganda bonus XP qo'shilib level QAYTA hisoblanadi — bir bonus yana level oshirib qo'shimcha bonus ZANJIRINI keltirib chiqarmaydi (faqat bir marta tekshiriladi), bu odatda OK. None handling yaxshi (s.xp or 0, s.level or 1). Faqat reset_all_xp dan keyin level=1 ga tushadi (XP=0 bilan mos) — to'g'ri.
findings.fix: Tuzatish shart emas; agar bir nechta levelga sakrash (katta XP) bonusni qator zanjir bilan berish kerak bo'lsa, while sikl bilan barcha oraliq levellar bonusini berish ko'rib chiqilishi mumkin. Hozirgi xatti-harakat ataylab ko'rinadi.

summary: database.py umumiy strukturasi toza (ORM, session-per-method, None handling, _calc_level mantiqi to'g'ri). Asosiy muammolar: (1) read-modify-write atomikligi nomuvofiq — add_xp va claim_room_xp with_for_update ishlatadi, lekin daily_checkin, increment_play_in_window, join_game_room ishlatmaydi, bu double-grant/lost-update va cooldown bypass xavfini tug'diradi (SQLite-da har qanday holatda no-op, lekin Postgres-ga o'tishda muhim); (2) award_referral_xp ikki alohida tranzaksiyaga bo'lingan — crash bo'lsa referrer XP butunlay yo'qoladi; (3) get_monthly_leaderboard DateTime ustunni string bilan solishtiradi va UTC/lokal vaqt mintaqasi chegara xatosiga ochiq; (4) Student.group_name va mars_id indekslanmagan (tez-tez filtrlanadi); (5) get_absent_streak_students da N+1 query; (6) bog'liq jadvallarda ForeignKey/CASCADE yo'q — student o'chirilganda yetim yozuvlar qoladi. Migration try/except pass additive ALTER lar uchun data-loss keltirmaydi lekin xatolarni jimgina yutadi.
